  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
WITH p.position AS position,
     date_diff('year', CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE),
       CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN DATE '2026-10-14' ELSE CAST(REPLACE(p.death_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) END) AS age

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p
WHERE (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 OR CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) < 1)
  AND p.position IS NOT NULL
WITH p.position AS position,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) END AS end_year,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) END AS end_month,
     CASE WHEN p.death_date IS NULL THEN 14 ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.death_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) END AS end_day
WITH position,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN position AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
